headline.text: L3 ML1 had *5 hours* of combined downtime on depositor jams, temper issues, and buffer tank failures across 3rd shift.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran three lines. S3 completed PRS Brookies changeover after clearing decoration pattern and tank contamination issues. S2 fought X-ray rejections all shift — over 100 pouches backed up by 16:50. S4 finished Crumbl order (266 cases, 26 over) and changed to Feastables.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ran FFS and ML3 with two brief cleaning pauses on FFS (totaling 40 minutes). Both lines steady otherwise. Materials verified for Monday startup.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML1 lost roughly 5 hours overnight to recurring depositor piston jams, buffer tank temperature drift, and a glycol spill during belt changeout. Truffle Line and MF Matrix ran stable; MF Matrix flagged elevated open flow-wrap scrap (1.07%) from upstream.

notes.text: S3 overproduced PRS Brookies by 11 pallets per IMS; Daniel Bringas cleared changeover to S'mores at 19:37.
S4 switched from Crumbl (21097) to Feastables One Shot (21117) at 15:35 after caustic wash.
Affogato Case8 FFS projected to finish 3.5 days early (July 29 vs. August 3); Zack Kurtz proposed skipping Salted Caramel Case5 changeover to go straight to Case8.
Truffle Line completed level 2 clean at 06:50; final ATP satisfactory.
Grey Boscan found wrong tempering chart (milk chocolate) and centerline (plain bars) on ML1 while running Crunch at 07:06.

resolved.title: S3 wrong decoration pattern on PRS Brookies
resolved.summary: Incorrect drizzle pattern applied; product from start of run placed on hold pending line clearance.
resolved.resolution: Pattern corrected and approved by QC at 12:48 — "drizzle pattern approved" (Charity Young).

resolved.title: S3 adhesive tape in decorator melting tank
resolved.summary: Mary Montilla found adhesive tape inside decorator tank at 14:21; contamination risk.
resolved.resolution: Tape removed with long tool; oil flush completed and QC inspection cleared at 14:47 (S3 Enrober).

resolved.title: S3 matrix machines seal/scrap issues
resolved.summary: Matrix units producing open, sealed, or burnt bags; 268 bags scrap at 08:00.
resolved.resolution: Troy Baxter dialed in pulsing and pouch opening by 08:19 — "MM5 looking pretty good."

resolved.title: S2 cooling tunnel 1 belt replacement
resolved.summary: Belt replaced by C&E maintenance; needs cleaning before restart.
resolved.resolution: Replacement finished 13:55 — "will need to be cleaned" (Chris Jeffs).

resolved.title: S3 caramel too firm — sticking and jamming
resolved.summary: Caramel sticking inside bags and jamming matrix machines; pieces firm at metal detector.
resolved.resolution: Cook temp raised 2°F at 14:53; Angelica Perez observed "improvements" comparing 16:00 vs. 18:00 samples, confirmed good texture by 22:10.

resolved.title: FFS blade and printer cleaning pause
resolved.summary: Line down to clean blade and printer.

resolved.title: FFS blade cleaning pause
resolved.summary: Line down for blade cleaning (second occurrence).
resolved.resolution: Running again at 17:21 — "We are running again!" (VFFS).

resolved.title: ML3 label issues causing brief stoppage
resolved.resolution: Resolved by 19:30 — "we are running now" (ML3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML1 cooler temperature out of range
resolved.summary: Cooler temp spiking; product not demolding correctly.
resolved.resolution: VFD faulted; Nelson Cook cleared fault and temp stabilized at 14:28 — "temp is coming down now."

resolved.title: ML1 glycol leak into depositor hopper during belt install
resolved.summary: Glycol leaked from connections into hopper while installing C3 belt; QA recommended purge.
resolved.resolution: Purged; no glycol signs after at 18:32. Scraped hopper sides and QA verified clear — "No signs of Glycol after the purge" (Tyson Fausett).

resolved.title: ML1 temper too hot on Crunch recipe
resolved.summary: Temper unit recipe so hot probe couldn't read; adjustments made but still 1.4 at 20:47.
resolved.resolution: Reheat performed; good temper (0.7) achieved at 21:52, depositing at 22:04 — "We got good temper" (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 PTL not pumping chocolate to buffer
resolved.summary: PTL stopped pumping; maintenance suspected clog but no screen installed for this product.
resolved.resolution: PTL valve was closed; operator missed it during auger overflow response. Valve opened, transferring at 02:57 (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML1 pin inspection cameras disabled for adjustment
resolved.summary: Photo eye turned at angle; inspection window misaligned. Cameras disabled while Leon investigates.
resolved.resolution: Loaded backup program and cameras back online at 10:45 — "back on" (Leon Brueger).

resolved.title: MF Matrix product not feeding into pouches
resolved.resolution: Cleared after lot change completed; line back up at 00:48 (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: MF Matrix HMI solid fill command OFF
resolved.summary: Switch 2 No. 11 solid product fill command was off; line stopped filling bags.
resolved.resolution: Switch turned back on; issue identified and corrected (Kimberly Morales).

needs_attention.title: S3 metal detector rejecting items every second
needs_attention.summary: Metal detector false-rejecting at very high rate; mechanics in area.
needs_attention.status: Mechanics working on it at 07:30; no resolution or update posted.

needs_attention.title: S3 decorator tank contamination requires full clean
needs_attention.summary: Box of chocolate found in decorator tank at 09:38; requires thorough clean and swab beyond the tape removal.
needs_attention.status: Tank requires "thorough clean and swab" per Jason Jensen at 09:38; tape removed and oil flushed, but full clean/swab scope unclear.

needs_attention.title: S2 X-ray rejecting over 100 pouches
needs_attention.summary: X-ray rejection rate spiking 13 minutes into 2nd shift; accumulation grew to >100 pouches by 16:50, forcing pause.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 17:26 to pass accumulation; issue ongoing as of 17:26 (Victor Mejia, Angelica Perez).

needs_attention.title: S2 melting tank shaft possible oil leak
needs_attention.summary: Dark substance observed leaking from shaft into chocolate at 01:20; maintenance believes it's chocolate, not oil, but monitoring continues.
needs_attention.status: Shaft cleaned; maintenance determined likely chocolate not oil (lubricant is clear). Monitoring shaft rest of shift as of 02:14.

needs_attention.title: S3 estop error on metal detector at line end
needs_attention.summary: Estop error on MD; cannot reset.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance on the way as of 07:15; no further update in window.

needs_attention.title: S3 C1 band slipped; tracking not working
needs_attention.summary: Conveyor belt tracking failure; mechanics already dispatched at 07:26.
needs_attention.status: Mechanics fixing at 07:26 (Nathan Topham); no follow-up posted.

needs_attention.title: S3 enrober return pump high pressure alarms
needs_attention.summary: Two high-pressure alarms on enrober return pump at 16:56 and 19:01; third at 19:01.
needs_attention.status: Three alarms logged (16:56, 19:01, 19:01); no maintenance follow-up or resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: S2 overflow printer date quality unfixable
needs_attention.summary: Overflow printer (used to correct bad dates) produces inconsistent print due to pouch curvature; ~100 pouches affected.
needs_attention.status: Troy Baxter confirmed unfixable — product in pouch makes flat surface impossible. Charity escalating to Chris G & Curt on Monday.

needs_attention.title: ML1 right side pistons jamming repeatedly
needs_attention.summary: Depositor right-side pistons stuck from rice and cooled chocolate; recurring issue across 3rd shift requiring multiple plate removals and washes.
needs_attention.status: Pistons jammed at 00:02, 01:20, 01:28, 02:38. Plate washed and reassembled by 02:10; depositing restarted but issue recurred. As of 04:19, whole block needs cleaning per Imperial.

needs_attention.title: ML1 buffer tank temperature dropping despite adjustments
needs_attention.summary: Buffer tank temp drifting down; maintenance made multiple adjustments but temp continues falling.
needs_attention.status: Temp dropping at 03:21, 03:47, 04:19. Maintenance working; temps started to rise at 06:49 but issue unresolved as of 05:15 (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

needs_attention.title: ML1 grease found on finished product
needs_attention.summary: One bar found with grease during line inspection at 05:53.
needs_attention.status: One piece with grease observed and photographed; no further update on source or corrective action.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix elevated open flow-wrap scrap from L2
needs_attention.summary: 1.07% open flow-wrap rate causing caramel to stick on plates, forcing production stops for cleaning. Issue sourced from L2 upstream.
needs_attention.status: Hopper cleaned at 08:21; Preston Tregaskis collecting data (15 lbs scrap, 5 min DT, 1.07% rate) to escalate to L2 formally.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Cavanna belt failure
needs_attention.summary: Belt on Cavanna is bad; maintenance dispatched at 05:21.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on it as of 05:21; no completion posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 wrong tempering chart and centerline on line
needs_attention.summary: Found milk chocolate tempering chart and plain bars centerline while running Crunch; documents not verified during changeover.
needs_attention.status: Incorrect documents discovered at 07:06; Grey Boscan flagged Supervisor 1 LSW verification gap.

needs_attention.title: ML1 sticker machine not working
needs_attention.status: Maintenance checking as of 07:06; no resolution posted.
